name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at each side with your palms forward.
Bend both elbows to lift the dumbbells toward the fronts of your shoulders.
Extend your elbows slowly until your hands return to your thighs.
tips: Keep your upper arms beside your ribs.
Avoid swinging your hips or shrugging your shoulders to lift the dumbbells.
